limits: No configuration save, restore or download in these tests.
No claim that every individual configuration field was modified or saved.
679 is the UI matching-setting count after clearing focus, not the full parser field count.
Ordinary-user, anonymous, mobile and effect acceptance retain their separately recorded scope.
Clearing search was verified with keyboard selection and Backspace; the browser fill-empty call did not clear the input and is not counted as a passed interaction.
